stock.description: Linklogis Inc. is an investment holding company that specializes in providing advanced technological solutions for supply chain finance throughout Mainland China. Their product suite includes Anchor Cloud, a platform designed to enable major corporations to digitally transform their supply chain management and optimize payment cycles for all parties involved. The FI Cloud offers financial institutions the tools to digitalize, automate, and streamline their supply chain financing services. Additionally, the Cross-border Cloud facilitates digital international supply chain financing and cross-border trade digitalization. Finally, their SME Credit Tech Solution comprises a collection of data-driven risk analytics, assisting financial institutions in extending financing to the small and medium-sized enterprise suppliers and distributors of these anchor companies. Founded in 2016, the company's main office is located in Shenzhen, People's Republic of China.
